title: Ben Tzitzit HaKeset
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Jerusalem Talmud Taanit 4:2 says he belonged to Avner’s family. Gittin 56a says he was one of Jerusalem’s three wealthy men at the time of the destruction. He was called this because the fringes of his garment trailed over cushions. Others say it was because his cushion was placed among the grandees of Rome.

notes.text: Rashi on Gittin 56a explains ציצתו as the fringes of his tallit, not his forelock. The second explanation concerns his cushion or seat among the Roman grandees.
